## What landed

### d1 — ruleset calibration over the real spine (D-META.1-1 → DONE)

Dated note: `docs/build/reports/2026-09-16_ruleset_calibration.md` — all
figures computed over the live corpus (**19,702 claims · 6,573 subjects · 19
sources · 79 predicates**), append-only (no spine row written).

- **Corpus caveat (load-bearing):** the corpus is single-epoch — `valid_period`
  is unbounded on every row and only 10.7% of claims carry `observed_at`.
  Half-lives are change-over-time constants; one epoch cannot falsify them.
- **Volatility:** 12 of 79 live predicates are registered (28.7% of claims);
  `deployment_exists` shows 0 churn across 4,957 subjects (consistent with
  SLOW/3y); the one real cross-source disagreement — `claimed_device_count`
  190 (bacy) vs 299 (deflock) — sits above the FAST 0.15 tolerance, so the
  constant provably does its job. `federal_award_id` IMMUTABLE violations trace
  to USAspending roll-up subject keying, not predicate volatility.
- **Directness:** 99.92% of claims carry the default `connector_run` evidence
  genre, which has no registry row — the resolver cannot grade them. Of the 16
  genre-stamped claims, 8 resolve to plausible grades; the matrix's published
  grades are unrefuted on the pairs that reach it.
- **Atlas supersession:** 5,373 Atlas claims / 4,756 subjects share **zero**
  (subject, predicate) pairs with any other source; `resolution`/
  `contradiction` tables are empty — ER has never run on the hosted spine, so
  the precondition for supersession does not yet exist (now a measured fact,
  not an assumption).
- **Outcome:** the documented defaults hold; **no constant retuned** — a
  single-epoch corpus cannot estimate change rates. Five recorded follow-on
  gaps: predicate-registry coverage (67 unregistered), `evidence_genre`
  stamping, USAspending subject-key granularity, a resolver run over the hosted
  spine (P25.10 is the natural carrier), `observed_at` coverage.

### d2 — records-request outcome backend fed from real MuckRock activity (D-META.1-2 → DONE)

- `tasks/src/tasks/request_outcomes.py` — the append-only `RequestOutcomeLog`
  (JSONL; request id, agency, coarse `state` + precise §11.19
  `response_status`, filed/response dates, observation source + vocabulary
  version). `outcome_from_claims` folds the spine's predicate surface;
  `outcome_from_api_payload` parses a platform api_v2 object through the
  caller-supplied versioned status map; an unmapped status fails loud.
  `feed_template_log` is the explicit, opt-in feed into the P10.3
  `TemplateOutcomeLog` (SIG-TASK-017) — `no_responsive_records` is excluded
  (an on-record agency answer, never a language failure, SIG-TASK-009);
  in-flight observations never move a rate.
- `tasks/src/tasks/data/request_outcomes.toml` — the status→state map and
  success/exclusion lists as versioned data (`outcomes_version 2026.09.16`),
  total over the frozen §11.19 enum (tested).
- `sig-tasks records-outcomes record|show` — CLI: `--claims` (JSONL/JSON claim
  rows grouped per subject) or `--payload` + `--status-map`; the log path is
  `--log` / `$SIG_RECORDS_OUTCOME_LOG` / `.sig/tasks/records_outcomes.jsonl`.
- `docs/build/tools/records_outcome_feed.py` — the live feeder: `--spine`
  folds the hosted spine's records claims; `--live REQUEST_ID` pulls one
  request through the connector's own politeness layer + refreshing JWT cache.
  A challenge or refusal is reported, never defeated.
- Fixture: `tests/tasks/fixtures/muckrock_request_136412.json` (the real
  api_v2 shape); 15 tests in `tests/tasks/test_tasks_request_outcomes.py`.

**Live results (2026-09-16):**

| path | outcome |
|---|---|
| Cloud Run `sig-ingest-muckrock` (execution `sig-ingest-muckrock-fx2ch`) | real api_v2 pull attempt, exit 0 → **0 new claims** (the API currently challenges even GCP egress — a recorded disappearance, never defeated) |
| direct laptop `--live 136412` | `ChallengeEncountered` 403 from `accounts.muckrock.com/api/refresh/` (Cloudflare) — **no outcome recorded**, honestly |
| egress probe `muckrock-egress-probe-twq24` | `200` on `https://www.muckrock.com/api_v2/` — GCP egress itself is fine; the challenge is on the accounts/refresh host |
| `--spine` fold | **request 136412 recorded**: `completed` (`fulfilled`), agency `265`, response `2022-11-30T20:10:37.860902-05:00`, filed `null` → `docs/build/reports/records_outcomes_2026-09-16.jsonl` |

The recorded outcome derives from the real P25.2-era api_v2 pull already
committed to the spine — no outcome was fabricated from the challenged pulls.
